item.title: No Entryway? 7 Small Apartment Entryway Ideas That Work
item.description: Does your front door open straight into the living room? These 7 small entryway ideas create a drop zone for keys, shoes, coats and bags without a real hallway. Most are renter-friendly and take less than a foot of depth. Save this for your front door area.

item.title: 7 Seasonal Clothes Storage Ideas for Small Closets
item.description: Small closet and two seasons of clothes? These 7 ideas show where to store off-season clothes in a small apartment: under the bed, on high shelves, in suitcases and more. You will free up hanging space and find things faster. Save this for your next closet swap.

item.title: Tiny Closet Organization Checklist: Fit More in a Small Closet
item.description: Small closet overflowing? This checklist doubles your hanging space and uses the shelf, floor and door you're probably wasting. Simple, affordable and renter-friendly. Save it for your closet clean-out.

item.title: 7 Small Bathroom Storage Ideas for Tiny Bathrooms
item.description: Tiny bathroom with no storage? These 7 ideas use the space above the toilet, behind the door and inside the shower to clear the counter. Most are renter-friendly. Save this for your bathroom.
